Script.name: SavsoulMapper
Script.script: SavsoulMapper = SavsoulMapper or {} for _, id in ipairs(SavsoulMapper.handlers or {}) do killAnonymousEventHandler(id) end SavsoulMapper.handlers = {} function SavsoulMapper.sync() local info = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info local id = info and tonumber(info.num) if id and id > 0 and roomExists(id) then centerview(id) end end mudlet = mudlet or {} mudlet.mapper_script = true if gmod and gmod.enableModule then gmod.enableModule('SavsoulMapper', 'Room.Info') end for _, event in ipairs({'gmcp.Room.Info', 'sysMapDownloadEvent', 'sysLoadEvent'}) do table.insert(SavsoulMapper.handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler(event, SavsoulMapper.sync)) end SavsoulMapper.sync()
